recipes.question: Which municipalities have grown fastest since 2015?
recipes.answer: Among municipalities with at least 10 000 people, the fastest growing from 2015 to 2026 were Lørenskog (+47%), Nannestad (+40%), Ullensaker (+38%). Norway as a whole grew 8.9%.

recipes.question: How has Tromsø's population changed since 2010, across the reforms?
recipes.answer: Tromsø had 67 305 inhabitants in 2010 and 79 943 in 2026, up 18.8%, counted within today's borders across the 2020 and 2024 reforms.

recipes.question: How did the parties vote on the proposal to curb energy prices?
recipes.answer: Representantforslag om tiltak for å dempe økte energipriser og levekostnader: the vote ended 68–29, adopted. Parties mostly voting against: FrP.

recipes.question: How do Bergen, Trondheim and Stavanger compare?
recipes.answer: Bergen: 294 860 people (+6.3% since 2016), 198 companies per 1 000. Trondheim - Tråante: 218 460 people (+12.9% since 2016), 192 companies per 1 000. Stavanger: 151 669 people (+7.8% since 2016), 192 companies per 1 000.
